newsitem.title: USA: Second back seat birth for Florida woman.
newsitem.headline: Second back seat birth for Florida woman.

text.p: The back seat of their 1991 Mercury Topaz will always be a special place for the Gaskins of Jacksonville.
Brenda Gaskin gave birth there on Tuesday -- for the second time.

Her husband Cleborne was driving her to St Vincent's Medical Centre after her contractions began when she realised she was not going to make it in time, Hazel Gaskin, Cleborne's grandmother, told Reuters on Wednesday.
A son, who has also been named Cleborne, was delivered in the car just outside the medical center's doors.
Two years ago the Gaskins also failed to reach hospital on time. Daughter Kensey entered the world in the back seat of the same car in a parking lot on the way.
"This time we kept telling her 'go early, go early'. She was ready I guess and didn't realise how ready she was," Hazel Gaskin said.
Mother and son are doing fine and the father is recovering from the drama too, she said.
"He's fine this morning but he was so nervous. He's glad it's over. He said next time he's going to go in two weeks early -- if there is a next time."
